description: This file is an ASP.NET application startup class for configuring MVC and Web API components, dependency injection with Ninject, and logging setup.

classes.name: MvcWebApiApplication
classes.description: ASP.NET application class configuring Web API, MVC areas, routing, filters, dependency injection, and logging during startup.

methods.name: OnApplicationStarted
methods.description: Overrides the application startup method to register areas, configure Web API, filters, routes, and initiate logging.

methods.name: CreateKernel
methods.description: Creates and configures the Ninject kernel for dependency injection, loading assemblies and setting the Web API dependency resolver.
